title: The parliamentary committee released a report on hospital staffing levels
text: Ottawa - The parliamentary committee released a report on hospital staffing levels on Wednesday, the committee chair said. The move follows several months of talks between lawmakers and industry groups. Economists said the numbers were broadly in line with earlier forecasts. The figures will be released next week following a routine review, officials said. A spokesperson declined to comment on the timetable beyond the published schedule.
